name: How Long Does it Really Take to Install a New Bathtub?

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Thinking about a new bathtub but wondering how long you'll be without your bathroom? The truth is, the timeline for bathtub installation can really vary. A super straightforward replacement in an existing alcove might be a quick job, but if you’re looking at significant changes, it’s going to take a bit longer. Understanding the factors involved helps you plan better and avoid surprises.

step.name: Step 2
step.text: For a pretty simple installation, where your new tub slides right into the old spot and plumbing lines up easily, you might be looking at just one to two days of work. This usually involves removing the old tub, making sure the area is clean and ready, setting the new tub, and connecting the basic plumbing for the drain, overflow, and faucet. It’s a relatively quick process when everything goes smoothly.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: However, things can get a bit more involved. If you need to make changes to the plumbing – like relocating the drain or supply lines – that adds time. We’re talking about more than just hooking up existing pipes; it's re-routing and securing new connections. Similarly, if we uncover any subfloor damage or framing issues after the old tub is out, that repair work will extend the timeline. And let's not forget about waterproofing and finishing the surround. If you’re getting new tile or a custom surround, that’s a whole separate phase that adds to the overall project duration.

step.name: Step 4
step.text: Another factor that can influence timing is permitting. If your project includes new drain rough-in, drain relocation, new supply rough-in, or any structural subfloor work, you might need a permit. This process takes time and could involve inspections. For complex projects, especially those involving plumbing relocation, extensive subfloor repairs, or intricate waterproofing, bringing in a qualified professional like HH Remodeling LLC just makes sense.
